summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a routine Form  ẞ 6-K carrying its September 30, 2026 interim financial report, the standard US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer. The XBRL tags reference segment revenue for Skytrofa and Yorvipath, convertible senior notes, Royalty Pharma royalty monetization arrangements, share-based compensation, and a September share repurchase program noted as subsequent event. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated.
